subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active-wake provenance be added as a new public `AgentSession.steer` options surface, or folded into the current queued user-turn transcript recorder path?
rationale: Current main already changed the same bridge to preserve queued transcript metadata, and the PR's stale API shape conflicts with that path and increases public SDK surface.

options.title: Fold into current transcript bridge
options.body: Carry provenance through the existing queue options and `UserTurnTranscriptRecorder` path so active wakes preserve both provenance and sender transcript metadata.

options.title: Accept a public steer options API
options.body: Keep the additive `AgentSession.steer` options surface, but require explicit SDK compatibility tests/docs and a refreshed surface budget on current main.

options.title: Pause for broader provenance API design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose one provenance contract for active wakes, spawned tasks, and transcript persistence.

recommendation.title: Fold into current transcript bridge
recommendation.body: Carry provenance through the existing queue options and `UserTurnTranscriptRecorder` path so active wakes preserve both provenance and sender transcript metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current queued transcript-context path that the PR must now integrate with.
